Title: Reduced child and maternal undernutrition in Pakistan
Description: Contribute to lower acute malnutrition among children 6-59 months and pregnant and lactating women (PLW) in priority districts of Punjab, Sindh, Balochistan, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and AJK.

Title: Children 6-59 months with acute malnutrition are detected early and treated to recovery
Description: CMAM: community screening, OTP (SAM), TSFP/SFP (MAM) and stabilisation centres (SAM with complications) meet Sphere performance standards.

Title: PLW and caregivers adopt recommended maternal and infant and young child feeding practices
Description: IYCF counselling, micronutrient supplementation and screening of PLW.

Title: Children 6-59 months screened for acute malnutrition by MUAC/oedema
Children with SAM without complications admitted and treated in OTP
Children with MAM admitted and treated in SFP/TSFP
Children with SAM with complications treated in stabilisation centres (NSC/SC)
PLW screened and malnourished PLW enrolled in supplementary feeding
PLW and caregivers reached with IYCF counselling sessions
Children 6-23 months and PLW receive micronutrient supplements (MNP, MMN, IFA)
Monthly community MUAC screening by LHWs and community volunteers
Refer screened SAM/MAM cases to OTP, TSFP or SC
Run OTP sites: admission, weekly RUTF distribution and follow-up
Run TSFP/SFP sites: RUSF distribution and follow-up
Operate stabilisation centres: F-75/F-100 and ReSoMal treatment
Manage nutrition supplies (RUTF, RUSF, F-75, F-100, ReSoMal, MNP, IFA, MUAC tapes)
Screen PLW by MUAC and enrol malnourished PLW in SFP
Conduct IYCF counselling sessions at health facilities
Conduct IYCF counselling sessions in communities
Distribute MNP to children 6-23 months and MMN/IFA to PLW
Monthly district reporting and data quality review
